And you know, I mentioned the process that you outlined.

But you know, it all depends on so many variables.
How, how we can work together and you know, what your stomach for it is and whether it's a long term play and how invested you are with doing it and how much you want to do of it as well.
So I mean it's a lot to kind of understand.
I mean this is all that we do, for instance, and if, if it takes a year and a half to do it, we will still be around doing it.

And so I joined in early January.
I joined a firm as a senior advisor called Oakland.

You know there are some, what is.
The size of the, the staffing agencies that you've got?

I mean there's other, you know, there.
Are other companies to be done.

Yeah, it's the same effort, sometimes even more effort.
Yeah, yeah, that's, that's exactly right.
Yeah, yeah.

In fact, more, more value than they could get if they just acquired one, one large company.
